title: fab0 step (.fab0/steps/<name>.yaml, or inline in a pipeline), schema 2
description: One unit of work with exactly one executor: an agent, a catalogue action, a shell command, or a tool call made by the session. Gates belong to the pipeline, because they are transitions between steps.

agent.description: Any Claude Code agent: `plugin:agent`, or a file in `.claude/agents/`. fab0 adds no conventions to it; the brief says what to read, write and return.

action.description: A catalogue action, run by the engine.

command.description: A deterministic shell command, run in the unit's worktree.

tool.description: An MCP or other tool, called by the session. Its result is recorded like an agent's return.

with.description: Arguments for an action or a tool. Strings may use `{run}`, `{run.<field>}` (the run's tracker item), `{unit}`, `{unit.<field>}`, and `{<step>.<field>}` (a field of an earlier step's return `data`).

skills.description: Skills the agent loads first: `plugin:skill`, or a skill in `.claude/skills/`.

instructions.description: Extra text for the agent's brief, for agents that aren't written for this step.

inputs.description: Artifacts the step reads, or `unit` for the current element.

paths.description: The step's write claim: globs, or `unit.<field>`. Units whose claims overlap don't run at once.

return.description: Fields the step's return may or must carry, beyond `summary`. `questions` pauses the unit until a person answers.

schema.description: A project-relative JSON Schema the return's `data` must match.

owner.description: The role whose turn the step is, or `repo-owner`.
